findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 1670, proof of citizenship to verify eligibility to vote
findings.note: Listed as a coauthor of HB 1670 (author Leach), which would require documented proof of citizenship to register to vote. Referred to the Elections committee on 2025-03-12.

findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 892, proof of citizenship to register to vote
findings.note: Listed as a coauthor of HB 892 (author Cain), which would require proof of citizenship to register to vote. Referred to the Elections committee on 2025-03-06.

findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 1312, proof of citizenship to verify eligibility to vote
findings.note: Listed as a coauthor of HB 1312 (author Hickland), on proof of citizenship to verify eligibility to vote. Referred to the Elections committee on 2025-03-10.

findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 2245, verification of citizenship status of registered voters
findings.note: Listed as a coauthor of HB 2245 (author Leo Wilson), which deals with checking the citizenship status of people already registered to vote. Referred to the Elections committee on 2025-03-14.

findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 5337, proof of citizenship to register to vote
findings.note: Listed as a coauthor of HB 5337 (author Isaac), which would require proof of citizenship to register to vote and creates criminal offenses. The committee report was sent to Calendars on 2025-05-07.

findings.motion: House cosponsor of SB 16, proof of citizenship to register to vote
findings.note: Listed as a House cosponsor of SB 16 (Senate author Hughes, House sponsor Isaac), which would require proof of citizenship to register, with a limited federal ballot for voters who cannot supply it. The committee report was sent to Calendars on 2025-05-25.
